opinions.point: Many commenters considered the finale highly entertaining, dramatic, and among the season's highlights.
The action and visual set pieces received enthusiastic praise, especially the climactic combat imagery and character power-up moments.
Several commenters liked the character development and felt the episode gave important characters satisfying emotional or thematic progress.
The ending generated strong excitement and anticipation, but many also found its abrupt twists and cliffhanger frustrating or overwhelming.
Some viewers felt the episode was rushed, with major confrontations resolved too quickly and lacking enough buildup.
A few commenters criticized an important defeat as insufficiently shown or anticlimactic.
